name: Tokuchika Yui
source:
Third-year student at St.Trea Academy and President of the student council. She is earnest and innocent. 

She easily believes what others say and is easily deceived. She says that "the main purpose of a student is to study" 

She is determined in her belief that "the school, which is a place of learning, does not need club activities for fun such as board game clubs!"

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/shangrila/chartop.html]official site[/url]]

•[b]Boob Shape[/b]
[b]Hemispherical[/b]
